subject: MAP Playbook Kickoff — roles, timeline, and next steps
content:
--- Message 1 of 5 ---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@orbitbio.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Playbook Kickoff — roles, timeline, and next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time earlier. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to keep alignment between Orbit Bio and Redwood on the evaluation and decision timeline. The goal is to make sure roles, milestones, and acceptance criteria are explicit so we can hit your target close in mid-November.

Proposed 6-week cadence (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): MAP kickoff, confirm champion and procurement contacts, share draft MAP and SOW
- Week 1–2: PoC / eval environment access, sample workload run, initial latency/cost snapshot
- Week 3–4: Deeper eval (scale tests, latency SLO validation), security questionnaire responses, legal review begins
- Week 5–6: Finalize SOW and procurement, executive review and close

Would you confirm these three quick things so I can finalize the MAP draft (attached)?
1) Champion / primary technical contact for the eval (you mentioned this might be Raj)
2) Procurement contact and expected PO timing
3) Any non-negotiable test cases or KPIs we should bake into the MAP (latency p50/p95 targets, sample throughput)

Attachments: Orbit-BIO-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP with milestones and owners), SOW-v1.pdf (initial SOW stub)

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to walk through the draft if that’s easier.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

--- Message 2 of 5 ---
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@orbitbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orbitbio.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@orbitbio.com
Date: 2026-10-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook Kickoff — roles, timeline, and next steps

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the clear plan and for sending the MAP draft. Quick answers:
1) Champion/tech lead: Raj Patel (cc’d) will own the evaluation from our side.
2) Procurement: procurement@orbitbio.com is the team; we typically need a signed SOW + internal approval which usually takes ~3 weeks once the SOW is final. I’ll push to accelerate.
3) KPIs: Our main pass/fail items are: p95 inference latency <= 400ms on representative batch sizes, reproducible token-cost estimates, and logs for data residency/audit.

We’re comfortable with the mid-November target but would like the PoC environment and data access in the next 5 business days if possible.

Happy to join a 30-minute call with you and Laura to run through the MAP — are you available tomorrow at 11am PT?

Best,
Samantha Green
Head of AI Platforms | Orbit Bio
samantha.green@orbitbio.com | +1 650-555-0199

--- Message 3 of 5 ---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@orbitbio.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orbitbio.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@orbitbio.com
Date: 2026-10-04T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook Kickoff — roles, timeline, and next steps

Samantha —

Thanks — that’s helpful. I’ll update the MAP with Raj as the champion and add a procurement milestone with the ~3-week internal review window. We can target PoC access by Friday (2026-10-09). I’ve attached a slightly annotated MAP with owners and a basic checklist for the PoC tasks.

Can Laura own the technical onboarding (test plan + acceptance criteria) and Karthik help with performance tuning advice during Weeks 2–4? Laura/Karthik — are you ok with those owners?

I’ll schedule the 11am PT slot tomorrow once I get a thumbs-up.

V

--- Message 4 of 5 ---
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orbitbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@orbitbio.com>
Cc: procurement@orbitbio.com, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook Kickoff — roles, timeline, and next steps

Vivek / Samantha —

Appreciate the plan. A couple procurement-side asks:
- Can Redwood provide a draft PO or payment terms that match the SOW stub (SOW-v1.pdf) so procurement can start the internal approval?
- For compliance: we need a brief summary of data handling and retention for the PoC (logs, KV cache behavior, and whether any PII will be stored). A one-page summary will do.

If you can send those by EOD Monday we’ll try to move the internal calendar forward.

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Senior Engineering Manager | Orbit Bio
raj.patel@orbitbio.com

--- Message 5 of 5 ---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@orbitbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@orbitbio.com
Date: 2026-10-05T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook Kickoff — roles, timeline, and next steps

All —

I’ll own the technical onboarding and will prepare a test plan that maps directly to the KPIs Samantha listed. Karthik and I will split the PoC tasks: I’ll run the environment setup and baseline runs; Karthik will work on model/quantization suggestions and cost/latency tuning.

Action items I’ll take by Tuesday EOD:
- Final test plan with acceptance criteria (doc link to follow)
- Baseline run script and sample dataset pointer
- One-page data handling summary for procurement (covers PII, retention, logging)

Vivek — please share the annotated MAP workbook and the draft PO template once you have them updated. I’ll jump on tomorrow at 11am PT for the walkthrough.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0120
